slices.focus: Jae-hyun adds weather hold sheet and post-storm review for credibility.
slices.summary: Learning from the previous August when weather became a blanket excuse, Jae-hyun adds a separate severe-weather hold sheet and post-storm review routine to the dispatch system. The sheet identifies departures genuinely blocked by severe conditions, while the review table compares true weather holds against sailings that still slipped for crew or paperwork reasons, protecting metric credibility through storm season.
open_loops: Ensuring post-storm review doesn't become busywork
